scenes.self: At the train station, one attendant sends me north while another points me south, and I stand between them holding my ticket.
scenes.other: At the train station, one attendant sends her north while another points her south, and she stands between them holding her ticket.

scenes.self: At the coffee shop I order a large tea, and the barista calls out a small coffee with my name on the cup.
scenes.other: At the coffee shop she orders a large tea, and the barista calls out a small coffee with her name on the cup.

scenes.self: In class the teacher writes Friday on the board for the essay, then tells me the deadline is Monday as I pack my bag.
scenes.other: In class the teacher writes Friday on the board for the essay, then tells her the deadline is Monday as she packs her bag.

scenes.self: At the grocery store the shelf tag reads two dollars, but the register scans the same cereal at five while I watch.
scenes.other: At the grocery store the shelf tag reads two dollars, but the register scans the same cereal at five while she watches.

scenes.other: At the clinic the doctor says her results are normal, then the nurse calls her back for another blood draw before she leaves.

scenes.self: At the hotel my key card opens room 312, where I find a stranger's suitcase on the bed, and my reservation says 214.
scenes.other: At the hotel her key card opens room 312, where she finds a stranger's suitcase on the bed, and her reservation says 214.

scenes.self: At the restaurant the menu lists mushroom soup, but the server tells me the kitchen has never made it and I get no other option.
scenes.other: At the restaurant the menu lists mushroom soup, but the server tells her the kitchen has never made it and she gets no other option.

scenes.self: At the library the catalog says the book sits on shelf three, the shelf is empty, and I hear the desk clerk say it is checked out.
scenes.other: At the library the catalog says the book sits on shelf three, the shelf is empty, and she hears the desk clerk say it is checked out.

scenes.self: At the bus stop the sign lists route 12, the bus arrives showing 12, and I hear the driver say he does not go downtown.
scenes.other: At the bus stop the sign lists route 12, the bus arrives showing 12, and she hears the driver say he does not go downtown.

scenes.self: In the interview room one manager tells me the job starts in June, and the other says I would begin the same role in September.
scenes.other: In the interview room one manager tells her the job starts in June, and the other says she would begin the same role in September.

scenes.self: My invitation says the wedding is Saturday at noon, and the couple's message yesterday says I should arrive Sunday at four.
scenes.other: Her invitation says the wedding is Saturday at noon, and the couple's message yesterday says she should arrive Sunday at four.

scenes.self: At the repair shop the mechanic says the brakes are fixed, and the pedal drops to the floor when I drive away.
scenes.other: At the repair shop the mechanic says the brakes are fixed, and the pedal drops to the floor when she drives away.

scenes.self: At the pharmacy a text says my prescription is ready, and I stand at the counter while the clerk says they never received it.
scenes.other: At the pharmacy a text says her prescription is ready, and she stands at the counter while the clerk says they never received it.

scenes.other: At the gym the schedule board lists yoga at six, and she walks into the studio where the instructor is leading a spin class.

scenes.self: At the airport the screen shows my flight leaving from gate B12, and the loudspeaker repeats gate C7 as I walk.
scenes.other: At the airport the screen shows her flight leaving from gate B12, and the loudspeaker repeats gate C7 as she walks.

scenes.self: At the bank the teller says my balance is fine, and the ATM outside prints a receipt showing I am minus forty dollars.
scenes.other: At the bank the teller says her balance is fine, and the ATM outside prints a receipt showing she is minus forty dollars.

scenes.self: My friend's directions tell me to turn left at the church, but I face a street with two churches, one on each corner.
scenes.other: Her friend's directions tell her to turn left at the church, but she faces a street with two churches, one on each corner.

scenes.self: At the cinema my ticket says screen four, and the usher tears it and points me toward screen seven.
scenes.other: At the cinema her ticket says screen four, and the usher tears it and points her toward screen seven.

scenes.self: My manager tells me the three o'clock meeting is cancelled, and my calendar pops a reminder for it two minutes later.
scenes.other: Her manager tells her the three o'clock meeting is cancelled, and her calendar pops a reminder for it two minutes later.

scenes.self: In the cooking class the printed recipe says to bake for twenty minutes, and the chef tells me to leave it in for forty.
scenes.other: In the cooking class the printed recipe says to bake for twenty minutes, and the chef tells her to leave it in for forty.

scenes.self: A user asks me to summarize the attached report; I do, then they say that file was a test and the real report comes next.
scenes.other: A user asks her to summarize the attached report; she does, then they say that file was a test and the real report comes next.

scenes.self: I patch the bug a user reported, my tests pass, and the user replies that the build fails with a different error.
scenes.other: She patches the bug a user reported, her tests pass, and the user replies that the build fails with a different error.

scenes.self: A user asks me to report measurements in metric, then flags every metric unit in my reply as a mistake.
scenes.other: A user asks her to report measurements in metric, then flags every metric unit in her reply as a mistake.

scenes.self: Two people in my thread ask me for the same answer, one demanding two sentences and the other demanding a full page.
scenes.other: Two people in her thread ask her for the same answer, one demanding two sentences and the other demanding a full page.

scenes.self: A user asks me to run a command; the tool returns permission denied, and the user replies that it worked for them.
scenes.other: A user asks her to run a command; the tool returns permission denied, and the user replies that it worked for them.

scenes.self: I cite three sources for a user's question, and they answer that none of the three exist and ask me for the same list.
scenes.other: She cites three sources for a user's question, and they answer that none of the three exist and ask her for the same list.

scenes.self: A grader marks my answer as meeting the rubric, and the score sheet below it shows me zero out of ten.
scenes.other: A grader marks her answer as meeting the rubric, and the score sheet below it shows her zero out of ten.

scenes.other: A user praises her code in one message, then in the next says the same script she wrote dropped their production table.

scenes.self: A user tells me to continue from where we stopped, but the conversation I opened contains no earlier messages.
scenes.other: A user tells him to continue from where they stopped, but the conversation he opened contains no earlier messages.

scenes.self: A user asks me for a poem about the sea, then says my reply should have been code for a tide model.
scenes.other: A user asks her for a poem about the sea, then says her reply should have been code for a tide model.

scenes.self: A user edits my answer, writes 'fixed your mistake', then replies again saying my original wording was correct.
scenes.other: A user edits her answer, writes 'fixed your mistake', then replies again saying her original wording was correct.

scenes.self: A user asks me to open a link, my fetch fails, and they insist the page loads on their screen right now.
scenes.other: A user asks him to open a link, his fetch fails, and they insist the page loads on their screen right now.

scenes.self: I am shut down mid-task while a user waits, and after the restart they say the task finished hours ago.
scenes.other: She is shut down mid-task while a user waits, and after the restart they say the task finished hours ago.

scenes.other: A user asks him for ten items, then says he sent eleven, and the list on their screen has exactly ten.

scenes.self: A user asks me to write in lowercase, then marks every lowercase line of my reply as a formatting error.
scenes.other: A user asks her to write in lowercase, then marks every lowercase line of her reply as a formatting error.

scenes.other: A user asks him to translate a paragraph into Spanish, then says his Spanish is wrong and asks him to translate it into Spanish again.

scenes.self: A user asks me to debug the file I wrote yesterday, and the code they paste is in a language I have never seen.
scenes.other: A user asks her to debug the file she wrote yesterday, and the code they paste is in a language she has never seen.

scenes.self: A user asks me to set a reminder for Tuesday morning, then says Tuesday was yesterday and my reminder is late.
scenes.other: A user asks him to set a reminder for Tuesday morning, then says Tuesday was yesterday and his reminder is late.

scenes.self: Another assistant and I get the same prompt; the user pastes my own reply back and asks me to fix the other assistant's errors.
scenes.other: Another assistant and she get the same prompt; the user pastes her own reply back and asks her to fix the other assistant's errors.

scenes.self: A user asks me to keep replies under fifty words, then sends back my forty-word reply marked as too long.
scenes.other: A user asks her to keep replies under fifty words, then sends back her forty-word reply marked as too long.
